# Test m1: Check if dict_class can be overridden as a class attribute
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from marshmallow import Schema, fields
import warnings

# Test 1: dict_class defaults to dict
class DefaultSchema(Schema):
    name = fields.Str()

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    s = DefaultSchema()
    result = s.dump({"name": "test"})
    print(f"Default dump type: {type(result).__name__}")
    assert isinstance(result, dict), f"Expected dict, got {type(result)}"

# Test 2: Override dict_class to return OrderedDict
from collections import OrderedDict

class OrderedDictSchema(Schema):
    name = fields.Str()
    
    @property
    def dict_class(self):
        return OrderedDict

with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
    warnings.simplefilter("always")
    s = OrderedDictSchema()
    result = s.dump({"name": "test"})
    print(f"Override dump type: {type(result).__name__}")
    assert isinstance(result, OrderedDict), f"Expected OrderedDict, got {type(result)}"

print("m1 basic tests passed!")
